caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular composition centered on a plain, beige background. Within the composition, there are two geometric shapes stacked vertically, each resembling a stylized block or patchwork pattern. Both shapes contain a central red rectangle, flanked on either side by short vertical blue bars. Next to the blue bars, there are yellow-tan vertical rectangles, and these are bordered by brown and gray vertically-striped patterns. The surrounding areas inside each block are filled with varying shades of off-white and light pink, with faint red lines running horizontally across both sections. The overall arrangement is symmetrical along the horizontal axis, and the outermost areas of the rectangular composition have a textured, stitched or dotted appearance, further delineating the edges of the patchwork-like design. The drawing uses a limited color palette that includes red, blue, yellow-tan, brown, gray, off-white, pink, and beige.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
